tasks.short: Read pleadings and motions to ascertain facts and issues.

steps.what: Locate the actual filed pleadings, motions and referenced exhibits in the court case system {OTHER}
Read documents on pleadings and motions, including the actual allegations, requested relief, qualifications and cited exhibits
Ascertain the facts asserted, disputed issues and gaps while distinguishing allegations from established facts
outputs: human understanding of asserted facts and disputed issues

tasks.design: Configure the native filed-document index in the court case system {OTHER} to expose the actual versions and exhibit links. The judge reads the full submissions and ascertains facts and issues; no generated summary substitutes for this work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding filed versions and linked exhibits can require repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case indexes can reduce document retrieval without applying law to facts.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding competing submissions and keeping allegations distinct from findings.

ambition.what: No additional case throughput or automated legal analysis is promised.

reach.learn: Preserve versions, exhibit references and access restrictions.

evidence.claim: A native court document index can reduce navigation while substantive judicial reading remains human.

assumptions: Boundary is reading and ascertaining issues, not writing a ruling or transmitting an order. No judicial report or case-note baseline is invented. Any separately required record writing must be allocated once to its actual drafting task.

The registry supplies actual case ID, document ID, filed timestamp, revision, exhibit reference and access restriction. Missing scans or disputed versions are resolved manually; no unverified extraction becomes a filed fact.
Test native indexing first. No model performs legal analysis, classifies allegations as facts or applies law. Access changes require the court's existing authorization process.
unknowns: Current index quality and actual judge navigation time.
research_questions: Can native exhibit links reduce retrieval without omitting filed revisions?

already_counted.description: Full judicial reading and ascertainment of issues remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain filed-document links and access metadata.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Retrieval alone saves 5.25 points, less 0.5 upkeep. Low is no deployment when the court index already supplies these links; no legal reading benefit is claimed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Rule on admissibility and testimony procedures.

steps.what: Read the actual evidence submission, governing materials and testimony-procedure request
Hear the parties' actual objections and arguments and clarify the proposed method of testimony
outputs: actual admissibility arguments and clarified procedure

steps.what: Decide the admissibility of evidence and methods of conducting testimony under the applicable law and actual case context
inputs: actual admissibility arguments and clarified procedure

steps.what: Formulate and check the exact ruling, reasons, scope and parties to whom it will be pronounced
outputs: checked final ruling and hearing recipient context

steps.what: Pronounce the checked actual admissibility or testimony-procedure ruling to the hearing participants
inputs: checked final ruling and hearing recipient context

tasks.design: Keep judicial reading, hearing, legal judgement, final ruling formulation and pronouncement human. Review native case-document access before considering a change; no repetitive administrative step inside this ruling workflow has a supported reduction.
tasks.previous_blocker: The core work is applying law to disputed evidence and hearing actual arguments.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing case access supports the work but does not establish a new saving here.
tasks.still_hard: Fairness, relevance, legal interpretation and procedural consequences.
tasks.human_edge: Independent judicial judgement and a reasoned ruling.

ambition.what: No automated ruling or expanded judicial authority is proposed.

tasks.altitude: No change to judicial work or decision rights.

reach.task: Understand the scope of the actual pronounced ruling
reach.learn: Keep a proposed ruling separate from the judge's final decision.

evidence.claim: Substantive admissibility decisions, final ruling formulation and pronouncement require contextual judicial work in this design.

assumptions: The actual ruling formulation and pronouncement are split from reading, hearing and judgement before assigning zero saving. A clerk's transcript or registry entry is outside the focal role and earns no transferred saving; a separate written judicial order must be allocated once if required.

The registry and parties supply actual filed evidence and arguments; authorized legal sources supply the governing materials. Missing or disputed materials are resolved by the existing court process, not a model.

Native case access was considered; the substantive document set is already available to the judge in this boundary, so no additional lookup baseline is invented. No new tool or recurring upkeep is proposed, giving zero incremental hours.
The judge's normal formulation check in s4 binds a1 to the exact final ruling and hearing recipients. Any change requires rechecking; no separate self-approval session is added.
unknowns: Whether a separate written order is required for a particular ruling.
research_questions: Which part of the formal order record is authored by the judge rather than the clerk, and where is it counted?

already_counted.description: Formulate, check and pronounce the actual ruling.

incremental.description: No new system or routine introduced.

approvals.approved_version: Exact final admissibility or testimony ruling, reasons, scope and hearing recipient context checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Reading, argument, judgement, ruling formulation and the actual pronouncement all remain unchanged. No report, transcript or send has been silently automated.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Preside over hearings and assess whether evidence supports charges.

steps.what: Retrieve the actual hearing case record, charge documents and filed exhibits in the court case system {OTHER}
Preside over hearings, listen to actual allegations and evidence and manage a fair opportunity for participants to be heard
Determine whether the evidence supports the charges, distinguishing what was alleged from what the hearing established
outputs: human assessment of evidential support and unresolved issues

tasks.design: Configure native hearing links to the actual case documents in the court case system {OTHER}. Keep presiding, listening and assessing evidential support human; no transcript, emotion inference or generated credibility score is used.
tasks.previous_blocker: Hearing references may require repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case links can make the filed set easier to open.
tasks.still_hard: Listening carefully and assessing evidence under the legal standard.
tasks.human_edge: Independent judgement and fair treatment of participants.

ambition.what: No faster hearing or automated finding is promised.

tasks.altitude: Slightly less reference retrieval; presiding and decision rights stay unchanged.

reach.learn: Identify actual filed exhibits without interpreting their weight.

evidence.claim: Native hearing links can reduce document navigation without shortening the hearing or assessing evidence automatically.

assumptions: Boundary is presiding and determining evidential support. Substantive pre-reading under 5647, admissibility rulings under 5645 and formal judgement drafting are not repeated here. A transcript is other-role work, not a free judicial saving.
The registry produces case ID, hearing ID, actual charge revision and filed exhibit links. Missing or restricted documents are resolved manually; no planned evidence item is treated as heard.
Test native links before code. No model or live surveillance is proposed; only retrieval is changed.
unknowns: Whether current hearing links already provide the full filed set.
research_questions: Does a native hearing view reduce opening and finding documents without changing reading or hearing time?

already_counted.description: Actual hearing and evidential assessment remain fully counted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Ten points of retrieval fall to 70%, saving 3 less 0.3 upkeep. No adoption if links already exist; hearing and judgement receive no reduction.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Award civil damages in relation to the court's or jury's findings.

steps.what: Review the actual court or jury findings, proven loss evidence and the issues remaining for a damages award
Determine the compensation justified by the actual findings and applicable law, including disputed heads of loss and limitations
outputs: human damages decision and explicit calculation instructions

steps.what: Check arithmetic for the exact amounts, dates and calculation rules chosen by the judge
inputs: human damages decision and explicit calculation instructions
outputs: checked arithmetic schedule with explicit assumptions

steps.what: Write the actual damages award and reasons, assembling the case identity and judge-chosen amount schedule
inputs: human damages decision and explicit calculation instructions
checked arithmetic schedule with explicit assumptions

steps.what: Check the complete final award, reasons, amounts, parties, case destination and exact issuance package
inputs: checked arithmetic schedule with explicit assumptions
outputs: checked final damages award and exact signature and issuance package

steps.what: Sign and commit the exact checked final damages award through the court's signing action {OTHER}
inputs: checked final damages award and exact signature and issuance package

steps.what: Issue the exact signed damages award to the authorized court registry destination
inputs: checked final damages award and exact signature and issuance package

tasks.design: Use existing {SPREADSHEET} formulas only for judge-specified arithmetic and native court templates {OTHER} for case headers and the checked amount schedule. Keep all legal reasoning and award wording human, followed by distinct final-version gates for signing and issuance.
tasks.previous_blocker: Case headers and explicit arithmetic can be repeated in award preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native formulas and court templates can reuse exact human-decided fields.
tasks.still_hard: Determining recoverable loss and giving legally sound reasons.
tasks.human_edge: Independent judgement connecting actual findings to the remedy.

ambition.what: No automated damages decision or broader judicial authority is proposed.

tasks.altitude: Slightly less arithmetic and header copying, unchanged responsibility for the award.

reach.learn: Distinguish arithmetic instructions from legal choices about recoverability.

evidence.claim: Native formulas and case templates can reuse explicit amounts and headers without deciding compensation or generating legal reasons.

assumptions: Boundary is the judge's award work through internal issuance. Registry service to litigants and payment enforcement are other work and receive no saving. Findings are actual inputs, not generated verdicts.

The registry supplies verified case and party IDs; actual findings and admitted evidence supply factual inputs; the judge supplies every amount, applicable date and calculation rule. Missing or disputed facts are resolved judicially. No formula selects a legal entitlement, rate or damages category.

Test existing court templates and verified formulas before code. No model applies law to facts. Only arithmetic mechanics and existing case-header or schedule copying lose time; legal reasoning and complete final checking remain unchanged.

a1 binds the exact final award and court signature envelope checked in s5. a2 binds issuance of that same content with the judge's signature to the exact registry destination. Any content change requires a new final check; ordinary signing and issuance retain full effort.
unknowns: Whether signing and internal issuance are distinct native actions.
research_questions: Can native templates preserve the judge's exact amount schedule without replacing any legal choice?

already_counted.description: Check arithmetic, author the award and verify its complete final content.

incremental.description: Maintain court-template fields and test explicit arithmetic formulas.

approvals.approved_version: Complete final civil damages award, reasons, amount schedule, parties and exact court signature envelope checked in s5
Issuance of the exact final award content checked in s5 with the judge's signature to the specified court registry destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Explicit arithmetic saves 3 points and case-header or schedule copying 2.7; gross 5.7 less 0.7 upkeep. Low is no adoption if native tools already remove that work. Judicial decisions, reasoning, signing and issuance get no benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The judge retains all hearing, evidential and remedial judgement. Native indexes and explicit arithmetic may remove small mechanical tasks.
reach: Work with judicial clerks on reliable filed-document links and explicit amount schedules.
skills_to_grow: Check arithmetic without delegating legal choices
role.ambitious_version: Use any verified mechanical saving for careful reading and reasoned decisions, without promising faster hearings.
